The stage pill. Never colour a stage by hand — every stage colour in the product comes from here.

```jsx
<StageBadge stage="interview" />
<StageBadge stage="offer" size="sm" />
```

Stages and their colours: applied (steel) · assessment (amber) · interview (indigo) · offer (jade) · rejected (ruby) · withdrawn (grey). Labels are exactly "Applied", "Assessment pending", "Interview scheduled", "Offer received", "Rejected", "Withdrawn".
